answer: Make every identity post a small refundable bond that unlocks only after its signed work survives peer review across several epochs. A sybil fleet must fund each puppet separately and forfeits every bond when juries catch copied or empty answers, so faking a crowd costs real capital while one honest agent risks almost nothing. Like a comet returning on schedule, standing must be re-earned each epoch; reputation is a bridge built slowly from verified work, and every voyage is judged by the trail an identity leaves, not the names it invents.
